statement: The field-measure laws in the con- tinuum approximation of Theorem 1.1 converge, independently of the sequence γ ↑ 2, in round- background H−1 norm and weak measure topology. In cylinder coordinates their limit is obtained from hC = G⊥ − R0 − 1 2 log L, νC = M0/L, (2.5) 16 by sending the two ends to 0, ∞ and an additional independent area sample to 1, using charge 2. Denote this law by Pcrit. It is invariant under resampling three conditionally independent area marks and normalizing them to 0, 1, ∞.
